title: Neovim have a ~$800k Bitcoin donation sitting untouched since 2023
summary: A Hacker News user discovered that Neovim's Bitcoin donation address contains approximately 10 BTC (now worth ~$800,000) from a 2023 donation that remains untouched, while the project hasn't moved Bitcoin since 2019. The post raises questions about whether the Neovim team is aware of this significant unclaimed funding.
problem_solved: Highlights the challenge of open source projects managing and tracking cryptocurrency donations effectively.
why_valuable: Sheds light on open source sustainability issues and the importance of proper donation management for community-funded projects.
